description:
Aloe-Ha parent, we're here to make your kid's bathing time cry-free, fun, and refreshing!

Little Joys Aloe Vera Shampoo deep cleanses your baby's scalp without causing any damage to its pH. A balanced pH =  irritation-free scalp!

This gentle formula also contains natural Oat, Sitaphal, Shea Butter, Papaya, Coconut, and Honey Extract, which help deep condition hair, improve texture and boost hair health.

All this for an ALOE-some bathing time!
Apply the liquid to your scalp. Gently massage until you see a lather. Once you have applied it to your hair, let it sit for a couple of minutes, and then wash it away.

howToUse:
Apply the liquid to your scalp. Gently massage until you see a lather. Once you have applied it to your hair, let it sit for a couple of minutes, and then wash it away

As a parent, I was happy to see a natural-based formula for kids! Little Joys Aloe Vera Shampoo is so amazing - I tried it myself and liked it, and now it was time to try it on my kid. Aryan fell in love with the bottle, and once I started using it on him, I was shocked at how gentle the formula was - he didn't even cry once. It was amazing on his scalp, and his hair felt so soft after it. I love that it is Dermatologically tested and free of toxins!
